title: Fourier expansion of the mod three indicator
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $x\\in\\{-1,1\\}^n$. The indicator that the integer sum of the coordinates of $x$ is divisible by $3$ equals $\\frac13+\\frac23(-\\frac12)^n\\sum_{S\\subseteq\\{1,\\ldots,n\\},\ |S|\\text{ even}}(-1)^{(|S|\\bmod 4)/2}(\\sqrt3)^{|S|}\\prod_{i\\in S}x_i$.
hypotheses_covered: Coordinate dimension n is a natural number
x is a sign vector of length n
